title: Machado Demands Lifting of Eligibility Ban After Judge Reveals Irregularities
detail: Venezuelan opposition leader María Corina Machado demanded the lifting of her eligibility ban after a magistrate revealed irregularities in the disqualification process that had barred her from running for office, intensifying pressure on Venezuela's judiciary amid the country's ongoing political transition. Former TSJ magistrate Bárbara César Siero said on Oct 6 that she was pressured to sign the ruling after relatives were detained in Dec 2023; Machado's Vente Venezuela party demanded on Oct 8 that the ban be lifted immediately.

media.caption: Vente Venezuela demands lifting of Machado's ban
